preconditions.description: The number of strings n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The integer k must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(a[i]) <= 100000 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each string in the array a must have a length between 1 and 100,000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n space-separated integers.
Each output integer must be non-negative.

postconditions.description: Each output integer must correctly count the number of valid substrings for each string in the array a.
